name: Short-side cross-asset coverage campaign
instruction: User 2026-10-15: test SHORT theses on every asset except BTCUSD (order US500, JPN, XAUUSD, NASDAQ, DAX, HK, GBPJPY, then USDMXN/USOIL), autonomously, then report one summary. Rule: every thesis on any asset must be tried on every asset (config/cross_asset_thesis_coverage.json).
pipeline: Gate A/B: hybrid fast grid default + FINE1 + FINE2 (~357 cells) at the asset's research cost (median spread) -> 2000-row floor -> Gate C: exact Bid/Ask replay of ALL Gate-B-positive cells, extra cost 0, delay 0 -> PBO/CSCV s=16 compound_velocity_stat, PASS = PBO<50% AND Prob[OOS<=0]<50% -> (survivors) geometry lock + Steps 01-09 + Gate D.

batches.shorts1: direct ports of every short family that exists in modern calendar-time form (20 from the USDMXN template, 3 HK-template shorts via fixed US500 copies, + overextensionfade/thrustcontinuation/trendefficiencycontinuation/openingrangereversion/volatilityshock/volatilitytermstructure shorts where missing)
batches.mirrors: new SHORT mirrors of modern live LONG families whose generator emits both raw sides: volatilitycarry_short, rangestructure_short (built on XAUUSD from live longs, then ported)
batches.mirrors2: timeregime_short mirror (built on DAX from the modern DAX/timeregime_long, then ported)
batches.legacy: 9 legacy BTCUSD-only/legacy short families migrated from bar-count to calendar-time labeling (2026-09-25 rollout recipe) on XAUUSD, validated, then ported: downsidejumpcontinuation, downsidevolatilitycascade, drawupreversalhazard, signentropycollapse, absorption, reversal, trend, trendpullbackcontinuation, volatilityregime
batches.legacy3: XAUUSD volatilityregime_short rerun solo (needs its own runtime's Bar_Volatility_Bps feature)

not_covered: upsidebreakoutfailure_short: no source code exists anywhere (only artifacts), cannot be built

near_misses.DAX/waveletcleantrend_short: Gate B 343 cells (default grid +0.057R net). Gate C 298/323 exec-positive, winner H50_E200_V17_PT1_SL1 +0.0503R (CI -0.010..+0.106), ~0.52 R/week. PBO 84.4% FAIL, Prob[OOS<=0] 20.3% PASS, slope -0.52. KILLED under the fixed both-must-pass rule; flagged for user judgement (ranking among ~300 near-identical geometries is unstable, but the selected winner is OOS-profitable ~80% of CSCV splits).
near_misses.HK/trendpullbackcontinuation_short: Gate C 88/183 positive, winner +0.016R; PBO 64.8%, Prob 52.1% -> KILLED_PBO.
near_misses.NASDAQ/rangestructure_short: Gate C 2/11 positive, +0.004R; PBO 71%, Prob 54% -> KILLED_PBO.
near_misses.DAX/trendefficiencycontinuation_short: Gate C 1/32 positive (+0.0017..+0.0037R, compound velocity ~7.6e-6); PBO not computable with 1 candidate -> killed as judgement (31/32 geometries lose at real Bid/Ask = selection artefact).

bugs_found_and_fixed: HK-template edges (and all 13 original live edges) compute calendar deadlines with bare DatetimeIndex.asi8 -> microseconds on venv312 -> every vertical deadline ~1000x too far -> zero labeled rows. Fixed in all ported copies (as_unit('ns')); scaffolder applies it automatically. LIVE edge folders NOT modified (live bot does not run research labeling) -- flag for the user.

campaign_asset.sh: Windows CRLF in python output left  on edge names when >=2 Gate-B positives -> Gate C silently skipped; also Git Bash strips literal CR from scripts (igncr). Fixed with tr -d ''; DAX shorts1 and GBPJPY mirrors Gate C were rerun.

make_mirror: primary_side_filter is a 0/1 keep flag (must stay ==1); rangestructure np.where(bias>0) must flip to <0; barrier-contract checks flipped. All mirrors self-tested (side=-1, PT below entry, SL above).
XAUUSD/timeregime_long is legacy bar-count: a mirror built from it was discarded (never gated) and replaced by the modern DAX-based one.

Legacy migrations: signentropycollapse tick-catalog lookup used start/end vs builder start_date/end_date; downsidevolatilitycascade/drawupreversalhazard catalogs used start/end (Gate C engine needs start_date/end_date/filename) -> fixed in 18 copies; reversal_short pre-existing NameError (barrier_hit vs hit) fixed; absorption_short bespoke 182-feature schema replaced by the uniform 168 schema (per standing rule); runtime.py pass-through renamed to vertical_horizon_hours; EVENT_VOL_LOOKBACK_HOURS alias added so v3_horizon_lab detects calendar time (control parity).
Runner: legacy export modules lacking SIDE_VALUE/EDGE_ID or returning only paths handled; transient 'live FFD continuation failed closed' guard handled by automatic retry (live state never touched).
